name: SPIKE - SI/PI/Thermal Analysis
description: Signal, Power, and Integrity Knowledge Engine - Professional multiphysics PCB analysis suite with PEEC/FEM solvers
description_full:
SPIKE (Signal, Power, and Integrity Knowledge Engine) is a world-class SI/PI/Thermal multiphysics analysis suite for PCB design. Features include:

• DC IR-drop analysis with current density mapping
• AC impedance analysis for PDN optimization
• PEEC-based parasitic extraction
• Thermal FEM analysis with reliability prediction
• Graph-based PDN analysis
• Professional wxPython Ribbon UI
• HPC-grade C++ solvers with OpenMP parallelization

Version 0.1.6.0 provides plugin infrastructure. Full analysis features coming in v0.1.7.0+
